data_fields.name: socket_offset_x
data_fields.donor_constant: seat attachment offset X (VehicleSeat.dbc, value not read)

data_fields.name: socket_offset_z
data_fields.donor_constant: seat attachment offset Z (VehicleSeat.dbc, value not read)

best_idea: Store each attached part as a local offset plus a yaw offset, and recompute its world pose from the parent every time the parent moves or turns, so sockets and seats never lag behind their base.
decision_why: Take the offset-and-relocate pattern and one transform function for hero sockets, but use the rig's full bone transform: the donor transform is yaw-only with no pitch or roll, and its own comment says that is not enough.
acceptance: A player sees the shield stay on its hand socket through a full turn and a stagger with no drift; a client test checks socket world position equals parent pose composed with the stored local offset within 1e-3 units after a 360-degree turn.
